what: Weighted Sum of Scores for Protein Network Modules
title: Weighted Sum of Scores for Protein Network Modules
text: WSSmod provides tools construct Weighted Sum Scores (WSS) module-level summaries proteomic data. Proteins grouped STRING network modules, sign-flipped align direction core biomarker association, combined single module score per sample using weighted average based network connectivity (alpha centrality) biomarker association strength. package accompanies Longo Lab plasma biomarker proteomics work.

title: Weighted Sum of Scores for Protein Network Modules
code: library(WSSmod)  expr_matrix <- matrix(   c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8),   nrow = 2,   dimnames = list(c("sample1", "sample2"), c("geneA", "geneB", "geneC", "geneD")) )  result <- data.table::data.table(   module = c("mod1", "mod1", "mod1", "mod2"),   symbol = c("geneA", "geneB", "geneC", "geneD"),   mean_beta = c(1, -1, 1, 1),   mean_alpha_scaled = c(1, 1, 2, 1) )  WSSmod::calculate_weighted_module_scores(expr_matrix, result) #> $scores #>         mod1 mod2 #> sample1  2.0    7 #> sample2  2.5    8 #>  #> $summary_stats #>    module   Min    Q1 Median  Mean    Q3   Max #>    <char> <num> <num>  <num> <num> <num> <num> #> 1:   mod1     2 2.125   2.25  2.25 2.375   2.5 #> 2:   mod2     7 7.250   7.50  7.50 7.750   8.0 #>  #> $module_sd #>      mod1      mod2  #> 0.3535534 0.7071068  #>  #> $module_proteins #> $module_proteins$mod1 #> [1] "geneA" "geneB" "geneC" #>  #> $module_proteins$mod2 #> [1] "geneD"

title: Calculate Weighted Sum Scores Using Signed Protein Values — calculate_weighted_module_scores
code: expr_matrix <- matrix(   c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8),   nrow = 2,   dimnames = list(c("sample1", "sample2"), c("geneA", "geneB", "geneC", "geneD")) ) cluster_result <- data.table::data.table(   module = c("mod1", "mod1", "mod1", "mod2"),   symbol = c("geneA", "geneB", "geneC", "geneD"),   mean_beta = c(1, -1, 1, 1),   mean_alpha_scaled = c(1, 1, 2, 1) )  # Calculate weighted module scores module_results <- calculate_weighted_module_scores(expr_matrix, cluster_result)  # Access score matrix scores <- module_results$scores  # View summary statistics print(module_results$summary_stats) #>    module   Min    Q1 Median  Mean    Q3   Max #>    <char> <num> <num>  <num> <num> <num> <num> #> 1:   mod1     2 2.125   2.25  2.25 2.375   2.5 #> 2:   mod2     7 7.250   7.50  7.50 7.750   8.0  # Check standard deviations print(module_results$module_sd) #>      mod1      mod2  #> 0.3535534 0.7071068
